title: Adjunct Professor of Public Policy
bio: Dhrumil Mehta is a Democracy and Technology fellow at the Ash Center for Democratic Governance and Innovation at the Harvard Kennedy School and a Database Journalist at FiveThirtyEight. He builds and maintains databases and writes and reports on issues around elections and politics. Dhrumil holds a Master’s degree in Computer Science from Northwestern University where he focused on artificial intelligence and natural language processing.
